version-0.3.109.label: Launcher news 2026-10-27 "Strongholds and home planters"
version-0.3.109.text:
Strongholds and home planters (2026-10-27, version 0.3.109)
Regeneration: Hunger and cold now really slow your regeneration. Blessings and enchanted clothing that speed up regeneration now work properly.
Contract boards: The hold inns across Skyrim now have contract boards.
Home planters: Ash Yams and Moon Sugar can now be grown in home planters.
